item.title: Spotify Wrapped 2025: Wizkid is the most-streamed artist in Nigeria
item.description: Nigerian Afrobeats star Wizkid emerged as the most-streamed artist in Nigeria, followed by Seyi Vibez, Asake, Burna Boy and ODUMODUBLVCK. BNXN, FOLA, Davido, Rema and Olamide completed the top ten, underscoring the continued dominance of Afrobeats, street-hop and related genres in the local market. Ayra Starr retained her position as the most-streamed female artist in the country, ahead of Tems and Smur Lee. item.title: Bien, Sauti Sol and Wakadinali top Kenya’s Spotify Wrapped 2025 rankings
item.description: For the second consecutive year, Bien, Sauti Sol and Wakadinali remain among the most-streamed Kenyan artists on Spotify, continuing a run that has seen them feature consistently in the country’s top 10. They performed strongly alongside international acts, including Drake and Kendrick Lamar, who ranked first and third respectively among all artists streamed in Kenya during 2025. item.title: GWM marks 18 years in South Africa with FAM Fest at Syringa Park
item.description: GWM South Africa marked its 18th anniversary on 31 November with the launch of FAM Fest, a public event held at Syringa Park in Muldersdrift that combined live music, vehicle showcases and family-focused activities. The celebration began with a convoy led by members of the GWM Owners Club and the Haval Ladies community, who arrived at the venue in branded vehicles. item.title: Late Solly Moholo to receive Lifetime Achievement Award at SAMAs
item.description: The late South African artist Solomon Majafela Molokoane, known professionally as Solly Moholo, will be honoured with a posthumous Lifetime Achievement Award at the 31st South African Music Awards (SAMAs), scheduled to take place on 14 December. The announcement was made by the Recording Industry of South Africa (RiSA), which oversees the annual ceremony. item.title: LYFE Festival 2025 to bring Sabrina Claudio, Lloyiso and Manana to Joburg
item.description: Johannesburg is set to host LYFE Festival 2025 on 6 December, an event that will bring together elements of R&B, soul and contemporary African sounds. Scheduled to take place at Marks Park, the festival places a spotlight on the growing intersection between local and international music influences in South Africa’s urban centres. item.title: SA: Veteran multi-instrumentalist Pops Mohamed dead at 75
item.description: South African multi-instrumentalist and producer Pops Mohamed has died at the age of 75. At the time of writing, details regarding the cause of death had not been confirmed. Veteran journalist and media trainer Gwen Ansell confirmed Mohamed’s passing in a detailed obituary, which explored his humble beginnings and the profound impact his music had on South Africa’s music landscape. item.description: The Prince Claus Fund is inviting creatives to submit applications for the 2025 Seed Award finding to 100 emerging artists working in contexts where cultural expression is under pressure. item.title: Pops Mohamed mixed old and new to reinvent South African music
item.description: By Gwen Ansell Ismail Mohamed-Jan – better known by South African jazz fans as Pops Mohamed – has passed away at the age of 75. His life in music represented a struggle against narrow, oppressive definitions – of race, instrumental appropriateness and musical genre. item.title: Nigerian rapper Shallipopi releases 22-track album AURACLE
item.description: Nigerian rapper and songwriter Shallipopi has released a new 22-track album, AURACLE, marking the latest addition to his growing discography. The release is accompanied by a new single, ‘Like That’ featuring Wizkid, which follows a series of collaborations that have widened the artist’s international profile. item.title: MIAF appoints advisory committees for fundraising and risk oversight
item.description: The Music In Africa Foundation (MIAF) has appointed a team of experts to serve on two newly established advisory committees. The committees were created to support the board in discharging its fiduciary duties and will focus on critical areas such as fundraising, membership strategies, human resources and risk management.
